I have resolved the issue by updating [`SQLDeleteCompiler`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwij35qz/django/db/models/sql/compiler.py#L1407-L1439):

1. **[`SQLDeleteCompiler.single_alias`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwij35qz/django/db/models/sql/compiler.py#L1409-L1410)**: Changed the check from `== 1` to `<= 1` so that unfiltered queries (such as `Model.objects.all().delete()`, where `alias_map` has not yet been populated with any table references) are recognized as single-table deletions rather than falling back to a subquery.
2. **[`SQLDeleteCompiler._as_sql`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwij35qz/django/db/models/sql/compiler.py#L1412-L1419)**: Added a fallback to `query.get_meta().db_table` when `query.base_table` is `None` (which occurs when `alias_map` is empty).
